description: Delegate evidence hygiene: worker cleanup route and process cleanup, safe evidence stories in /prd, and a merge-conflict cause for /ci-status NO-RUN.

userStories.title: Name the cleanup route and process cleanup in the worker brief
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want each worker to clean up worktrees, branches, and processes through the sanctioned route. The advisor then stops resolving guard blocks and orphan processes by hand.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md` § Worker brief has a rule that a worker removes a worktree only with `bash .agro/scripts/git-maintenance.sh worktree-remove <path>` and deletes a branch only with `bash .agro/scripts/git-maintenance.sh branch-delete <branch>`.
§ Worker brief has a rule that a worker stops each process that the worker starts before the worker reports, and reports each process that the worker cannot stop.
§ Worker brief has a rule that a worker never stops a process that the worker did not start.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md` reports no finding on a changed line.
userStories.notes: executed: ste-check on .agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md reports no findings on the integrated branch. reasoned (section read back): Worker brief names git-maintenance.sh worktree-remove and branch-delete and links /git; workers stop each process they start, report each they cannot stop, and never stop a process they did not start. pnpm test runs at Close.

userStories.title: Make evidence stories safe to run
userStories.description: As a worker, I want the evidence rules of `/prd` to match the guards and the shared environment. An evidence story then runs without an advisor decision.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` § Stories states that an evidence story passes environment values inline on the command and never writes an env file.

§ Stories states that, before a live or local boot, the evidence story checks that each port the boot binds is free. If a port is busy, the story sets `blocked`, names the process that holds the port, and stops no process.

§ 3 Ground the plan states that each route, path, and command that the plan cites resolves on the current node, and that the plan names a placeholder and an open question for each one that does not resolve.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` reports no finding on a changed line.
userStories.notes: executed: ste-check on .agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md reports no findings on the integrated branch. reasoned (diff read): the Stories section passes environment values inline and never writes an environment file; a port check before a live or local boot sets blocked, names the holder, and stops no process; section 3 requires each cited route, path, and command to resolve on the current node or to get a placeholder and an open question.

userStories.title: Report a merge conflict as the cause of NO-RUN
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want `/ci-status` to name a merge conflict when an open PR has no checks. I then merge the base branch at once instead of waiting.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/ci-status/SKILL.md` step 2 runs `gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --json mergeable --jq .mergeable` when `gh pr checks` prints no rows.

When that command prints `CONFLICTING`, the skill reports NO-RUN with the cause: the PR conflicts with its base branch, and GitHub runs no `pull_request` workflow until the author merges the base branch.
The NO-RUN entry of step 6 names the conflict cause.
The skill still reports exactly one of PASS, FAIL, NO-RUN, or TIMEOUT.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/ci-status/SKILL.md` reports no finding on a changed line.
userStories.notes: executed: ste-check on .agro/skills/ci-status/SKILL.md reports no findings; the worker ran bash -n on the new block. reasoned (section read back): step 2 runs gh pr view with mergeable when gh pr checks prints no rows; CONFLICTING reports NO-RUN with the merge conflict cause; the step 6 NO-RUN entry names the cause; outcomes stay PASS, FAIL, NO-RUN, TIMEOUT. integration: the worker amended its commit, so the advisor applied the diff from 25c41138 to the final 021c2ace; the file equals 021c2ace.
